reason: The context accepts the fixture's self-signed certificate, which Chromium refuses per context (acceptInsecureCerts is Unsupported there: CDP ignores certificate errors browser-wide). The matrix row says Strider has the option, with Chromium refusing true in its notes
Upstream runs it on Chromium only: showDirectoryPicker, the File System Access API's picker, exists only in Chromium
Upstream runs it on WebKit only: window.safari is a Safari and WebKit global that other engines don't define
The test installs a virtual authenticator with context.credentials.install(), which Strider has no context-wide credential API for
